text: Excuse me.  Could I ask you a few questions?
source_text: Excuse me.  Could I ask you a few questions?

text: 打扰一下，我能问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 打扰一下，我能问你一些问题吗？

text: Get back over to the Eastside, you hop head!
source_text: Get back over to the Eastside, you hop head!

text: 滚回你的老家去，你这个瞌药仔！
source_text: 滚回你的老家去，你这个瞌药仔！

text: Make it quick.  I'm not supposed to be talking on the job.
source_text: Make it quick.  I'm not supposed to be talking on the job.

text: 快点说。我不能在工作的时候瞎扯。
source_text: 快点说。我不能在工作的时候瞎扯。

text: You'd better watch your step and your mouth, punk!
source_text: You'd better watch your step and your mouth, punk!

text: NO!  You'd better watch it!  I'm gonna' put a bullet in your head!
source_text: NO!  You'd better watch it!  I'm gonna' put a bullet in your head!

text: 不！你最好看好你的嘴！我会请你吃花生米！
source_text: 不！你最好看好你的嘴！我会请你吃花生米！

text: 我不能在你身上浪费时间。
source_text: 我不能在你身上浪费时间。

text: If you don't know, you probably shouldn't be here.  This is the Heights.  Mister Hightower lives here# and he only sees people on appointment.
source_text:
If you don't know, you probably shouldn't be here.  This is the Heights.  Mister Hightower lives here
# and he only sees people on appointment.

text: 如果你不知道，你就不应该在这里。这里是哈勃高地，海托先生住在这里，他只见预约过的客人。
source_text: 如果你不知道，你就不应该在这里。这里是哈勃高地，海托先生住在这里，他只见预约过的客人。

text: Can I set up an appointement with Mr. Hightower?
source_text: Can I set up an appointement with Mr. Hightower?

text: 我可以和海托先生约个见面时间吗？
source_text: 我可以和海托先生约个见面时间吗？

text: I'm here to make sure nobody messes with Mr. Hightower.
source_text: I'm here to make sure nobody messes with Mr. Hightower.

text: 我负责确保海托先生不受打扰。
source_text: 我负责确保海托先生不受打扰。

text: Well, I'm actually interested in killing Mr. Hightower.  It's time to earn your pay!
source_text: Well, I'm actually interested in killing Mr. Hightower.  It's time to earn your pay!

text: 很好，我实际上对怎样杀死海托先生很有兴趣。现在先让我搞定你！
source_text: 很好，我实际上对怎样杀死海托先生很有兴趣。现在先让我搞定你！

text: I don't like your attitude.  You'd better leave.
source_text: I don't like your attitude.  You'd better leave.

text: 我不喜欢你的态度。你最好马上离开。
source_text: 我不喜欢你的态度。你最好马上离开。

text: Make me, you damn long-haired freak!
source_text: Make me, you damn long-haired freak!

text: 来干我呀，你这个长毛怪物！
source_text: 来干我呀，你这个长毛怪物！

text: After sundown nobody is allowed in this area.  The other guards won't even give you a warning.  If they# catch you they'll attack.  You'd better get back downtown while your head is still attached to your neck.
source_text:
After sundown nobody is allowed in this area.  The other guards won't even give you a warning.  If they

text: 晚上不允许有陌生人在这个地方。如果换了别人连警告都不会给，直接把你干掉。你最好趁脑袋没搬家时回到镇子里去。

text: Sorry, I'll be on my way.
source_text: Sorry, I'll be on my way.

text: Man, you are rock-stupid, aren't you?  Take a hike!
source_text: Man, you are rock-stupid, aren't you?  Take a hike!

text: 小子，你简直是个花岗岩，离我远点！
